nodes.description: Private owner address stored in Ownable; set to deployer in constructor and updated by transferOwnership/renounceOwnership.
Immutable interface pointer to the QANX token (IERC20L) at 0xAAA7A10a8ee237ea61E8AC46C50A8Db8bCC1baaa.
Immutable interface pointer to the USDT token (IERC20) at 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7.
Public mapping(address => Offer) holding per-buyer sale offers; read in receive() and mutated by makeOffer/cancelOffer/receive.
Caller-controlled address, surfaced through _msgSender(); used as offer key, allowance owner and transfer recipient.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to derive offer expiry in makeOffer and to validate claimability in receive.
Ownable constructor; reads _msgSender() and stores the deployer as _owner.
Context helper returning msg.sender; the single source of caller identity for owner checks and offer keys.
Context helper returning msg.data; unused by the custom logic.
Public view returning the stored _owner address.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0), permanently disabling owner-only functionality.
onlyOwner function that reassigns _owner to the newOwner parameter.
Access-control modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender() before executing the guarded function body.
onlyOwner function that creates/scales an Offer for a buyer, converting amounts and computing claimableHours from block.timestamp.
onlyOwner function that deletes the offer entry for a given buyer address.
Payable fallback claiming an offer: validates expiry and allowances, then pulls USDT and QANX and transfers locked QANX to the caller.
onlyOwner function forwarding the contract's entire USDT balance to a beneficiary address.
Assignment offers[_toBuyer] = Offer({...}) performing _qanxAmount*10**18, _usdtAmount*10**6 and block.timestamp + _claimableHours*3600 scaling/arithmetic.
External _usdt.transferFrom(_msgSender(), address(this), usdtAllowance) call executed inside receive() before the offer is cleared.
External _qanx.transferFrom(owner(), address(this), offer.qanxAmount) call executed inside receive() before the offer is cleared.
External _qanx.transferLocked(_msgSender(), amount, hardLockUntil, softLockUntil, allowedHops) call executed inside receive() before the offer is cleared.
delete offers[_msgSender()] state update performed after all external token calls, enabling re-entrant re-claims.
External _usdt.transfer(_beneficiary, _usdt.balanceOf(address(this))) call in claimPurchasePrice.
makeOffer parameter: buyer address used as the offers mapping key.
makeOffer parameter: QANX amount scaled by 10**18 into the Offer.
makeOffer parameter: USDT amount scaled by 10**6 into the Offer.
makeOffer parameter: hours offset multiplied by 3600 and added to block.timestamp.
makeOffer parameter: stored hard lock timestamp for the bought tokens.
makeOffer parameter: stored soft lock timestamp for gradual release.
makeOffer parameter: number of further transfers allowed on the locked tokens.
cancelOffer parameter: buyer address whose offer entry is deleted.
claimPurchasePrice parameter: recipient of the contract's USDT balance.
transferOwnership parameter: address that becomes the new _owner.
receive() local caching _qanx.allowance(owner(), address(this)) for the sufficiency check.
receive() local caching _usdt.allowance(_msgSender(), address(this)) and reused as the transferFrom amount.
Constructor local holding _msgSender() before it is written to _owner.

edges.reason: Constructor calls _msgSender() to obtain the deployer address.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender, which flows into the ownership assignment.
Constructor writes the caller-derived address into the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
makeOffer is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
cancelOffer is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
claimPurchasePrice is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner invokes owner() to read the current owner.
owner() returns the value of the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares owner() against _msgSender() to authorize the caller.
transferOwnership consumes the newOwner parameter before reassigning ownership.
transferOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into the _owner state variable.
makeOffer takes the buyer address parameter that keys the offers mapping.
_toBuyer is the mapping key in the offers[_toBuyer] = Offer({...}) assignment.
_qanxAmount is multiplied by 10**18 when building the Offer struct.
_usdtAmount is multiplied by 10**6 when building the Offer struct.
_claimableHours is multiplied by 3600 to derive the claimable window.
block.timestamp is added to _claimableHours*3600, making the stored expiry miner/time dependent.
_hardLockUntil is written into the Offer struct.
_softLockUntil is written into the Offer struct.
_allowedHops is written into the Offer struct.
The Offer assignment stores the new offer into the offers mapping.
cancelOffer consumes the _ofBuyer address parameter.
_ofBuyer is used as the key when deleting the offers entry.
cancelOffer deletes offers[_ofBuyer] from the offers mapping.
receive() calls _msgSender() to identify the claiming buyer.
receive() compares offers[_msgSender()].claimableHours against block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
receive() stores the computed QANX allowance in the qanxAllowance local.
_qanx.allowance(owner(), address(this)) is read into qanxAllowance.
receive() stores the buyer's USDT allowance in the usdtAllowance local.
_usdt.allowance(_msgSender(), address(this)) is read into usdtAllowance.
usdtAllowance is passed directly as the amount of the _usdt.transferFrom call.
receive() executes the external _usdt.transferFrom call.
The _usdt token instance is the target of the transferFrom call.
receive() executes the external _qanx.transferFrom call.
The _qanx token instance is the target of the transferFrom call.
receive() executes the external _qanx.transferLocked call.
The _qanx token instance is the target of the transferLocked call.
msg.sender is the recipient of the externally called transferLocked, giving the callee control flow before state cleanup.
The external _usdt.transferFrom call completes before offers[_msgSender()] is deleted, allowing re-entrant claims.
The external _qanx.transferFrom call executes before the offer state update, leaving the stale offer usable in a nested call.
The external _qanx.transferLocked call precedes the delete of the offer, enabling repeated withdrawal.
receive() deletes the caller's offer after the token transfers.
The delete operation clears the offers mapping entry keyed by the caller.
msg.sender determines which offer entry is deleted after the external calls complete.
claimPurchasePrice consumes the _beneficiary address parameter.
_beneficiary is passed as the recipient of the _usdt.transfer call.
claimPurchasePrice executes the external _usdt.transfer of the contract balance.
The _usdt token instance is the target of the transfer call.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _toBuyer is only used as the key of the offers assignment unsafe operation in makeOffer.
Parameter _qanxAmount flows exclusively into the scaled Offer assignment.
Parameter _usdtAmount flows exclusively into the scaled Offer assignment.
Parameter _claimableHours flows exclusively into the timestamp-based Offer assignment.
Parameter _hardLockUntil is stored directly by the Offer assignment.
Parameter _softLockUntil is stored directly by the Offer assignment.
Parameter _allowedHops is stored directly by the Offer assignment.
Parameter _ofBuyer is consumed only by cancelOffer when deleting the offers entry.
Parameter _beneficiary is used solely as the recipient of the USDT transfer unsafe operation.
Parameter newOwner is consumed only by transferOwnership when rewriting _owner.
Local qanxAllowance is a receive() scratch value for the allowance sufficiency check.
Local usdtAllowance is reused directly as the amount of the _usdt.transferFrom unsafe operation.
Constructor local msgSender is a temporary alias for _msgSender() before it is written to _owner.
